Why Dessert Duo?

Baked with love, every time

We're a small home bakery in Nairobi making every batch fresh to order — no preservatives, no shortcuts.

Freshly Baked

Every order goes straight into the oven. You'll always get cookies and cupcakes at their absolute best.

7 Cookie Flavours

From classic chocolate chip to gooey Nutella and dreamy marshmallow — there's something for everyone.

9 Cupcake Flavours

Beautifully frosted cupcakes in classic and seasonal flavours, with custom toppings available.

Perfect for Gifting

Beautifully packaged 6-packs and 12-packs — great for birthdays, events, or treating yourself.

Ordering is Easy

How to get your treats

1

Browse the Menu

Choose your cookie or cupcake flavours, pick a pack size, and add toppings if you like.

2

Contact Us

DM us on Instagram or TikTok, or send a WhatsApp. We'll confirm your order right away.

3

We Bake Fresh

Your order goes straight into the oven. Freshly made, never pre-baked.

4

Enjoy!

Collect or get it delivered. Open the box, take a photo, and dig in — you deserve it.
